expectations.text: Describes the release model: year-based naming with an annual cycle (summer publication, effective January 1 following; ISA2028 expected summer 2027)
expectations.evidence: "Year-based naming replaces version numbers (ISA2027, then ISA2028 expected summer 2027)... published each summer, effective January 1 of the following year."

expectations.text: IS module: 46 controls retained, with analyses counting ~44 edited and substantive requirement changes in ~25 (counts attributed to analyses, not ENX)
expectations.evidence: "Still 46 controls... About 44 of 46 were edited or clarified, with substantive requirement changes in roughly 25"; counts framed as approximate workbook analyses ("consultancy analyses... treat them as approximate").

expectations.text: Prototype module: restructured from five control groups to TWO domains — Organizational Requirements and Physical & Environmental Security — at 20 controls, with new traceability/lifecycle and disposal/return controls
expectations.evidence: "Reduced from 22 to 20 controls. Five control groups become two domains: Organizational Requirements, and Physical & Environmental Security... New controls for traceability and lifecycle, and for disposal, recycling and return."

expectations.text: New PTS label structure: Prototype Protection Basic (AL2) and Prototype Protection Facilities (AL3), Facilities encompassing Basic
expectations.evidence: "Prototype Protection Basic (AL2) and Prototype Protection Facilities (AL3), with Facilities encompassing Basic."

expectations.text: Mentions supply-chain strengthening (high: documented supplier monitoring; very high: TISAX label, equivalent assessment or supplier audit) and updated mappings (NIST CSF 2.0, refined ISO 27001:2022, 2013 references removed)
expectations.evidence: "High protection need: documented supplier monitoring... Very high... TISAX label, an equivalent third-party assessment, or a supplier audit"; "Updated to NIST CSF 2.0 and refined ISO/IEC 27001:2022. All ISO 27001:2013 references removed."
